hook_text: A glass jar starts life as a pile of beach sand. A jersey starts on the back of a sheep. How?
clip_script: Where does it come from? A glass jar: melted sand! A clay mug: soft clay, baked hard in a kiln. A plastic bottle: chemicals from oil and coal. A newspaper: wood mashed into pulp. A jersey: wool from a sheep, spun and knitted. A leather shoe: cow hide, tanned so it will not rot. Raw materials come from nature. Manufactured materials are made by people. Look around you. Everything started somewhere.
visual_style: Whiteboard arrows from raw materials to products: sand to a jar, clay to a mug, coal and oil to a bottle, wood to a newspaper, wool to a jersey, hide to a shoe.
mood: Like a factory tour full of surprises.
pacing: Six quick before-and-after pairs, each with one big change in the middle.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and trace three things in your kitchen back to their raw materials.
